title: Asked Codex Astra to make me a 3D axe-man sprite animation. Not Good.
author: affabledrunk
selftext:
I asked it to clone the Berserker from Civ3.

How are people getting good models and animation?

comments.author: dilberry
comments.body: Astra (and Opus) both suck at 3d modeling. Everyone is using Tripo, Meshy, a local model like Hunyuan or Pixel3d or Trellis.2, or doing it by hand.

replies.author: redditscraperbot2
replies.body: This is not true, both Astra and Opus are fantastic at architectural design, buildings, layout etc and can ever do decent texturing work provided they are given the right tools. Comparing trip and an LLM is like comparing a drill to a hammer.

replies.author: FondantIcy866
replies.body: What tools? And what does your drill metaphor mean? Thanks

replies.author: redditscraperbot2
replies.body:
You can’t get mushy to generate a coherent floor layout from an image of a building. Astra and opus can.

The work they do in 3D is fundamentally different. Where meshy or whatever 3D model of your choice will replicate a shape from an image, an llm will create coherent shapes with purpose but often lacks on fine sculpted detail.

replies.author: Lyefyre
replies.body:
It's not that they suck at animating itself, it's just that they suck at artistic design and have no idea, how something should move.  
For better results, always specificy what the motion should convey (Heavy Attack, dangerous), start and endpoint of the axe (overhead swing, starting from the back, ending in a clear arc in front of the character) and if you have visual references, even better.

Also tell the ai to use IK (Inverse Kinematics) so the bones follow a logical structure, which should prevent joints turning and contorting unnaturally.

comments.author: mikerz85
comments.body: you'd do better if you created a workflow and included agentic review during the process. eg, it can't finish until it passes your reviewers and it's also aware of the bar to pass. One of those reviewers would literally just compare the original to what it produced to ensure it's the right shape and moving the same way.

comments.author: InSilicoAwards
comments.body: Use Minimax and render the video, then run it through the Fab mocap tool in Unreal.

comments.author: ponderdiggums
comments.body:
I generally draw the concept in 2d, have astra give me a high detail render of it from 4 angles, make the model in Tripo and then use Astra to do the cleanup work and make the model to spec, apply anims, etc. Tripo has some decent animations, you can also grab animations for bipeds from Mixamo.

Cleanup and getting the model looking good at different specs is where I spend the most time and labor. It's not a perfect system, but it's a decent little art pipeline that lets me convert my drawings pretty quickly and I'm proud of what I've built thus far.

Included some images of my own trials with different models. They're mostly ass out of the gate.
